{{Top|leg}}
A '''concussion mine''' was a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed concussion mines in the [[Sevarcos system/Legends|Sevarcos system]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] equipped with close-proximity [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] in an effort to deter [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
